points.description: Names and describes two valid challenges of mobile routing compared to fixed/wired networks (e.g. adaptation to topology changes/nodes joining and leaving, security, medium access control such as hidden/exposed/near-far terminals, QoS, scalability, heterogeneity, dependability, power consumption). Each challenge must be named and given a correct description; any valid challenge counts even if not the one a peer chose. Optional extra examples are not required.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) if only one valid challenge is both named and described correctly, or if two are named but only one is described adequately.
